title: ElTo World
description: One ElTo world: a complete theme package from bootloader to mouse cursor. Extends the shell theme.json format (version 1) with optional per-layer sections. Every layer section is optional; a missing layer stays at its default.

name.description: World id, matches the directory name under elto-worlds/.

label.description: Human name shown in the Themes page.

version.description: 2 = world format. Version 1 files (shell-only theme.json) are still accepted by the shell.

license.description: License of the world definition itself.

assetsLicense.description: License of bundled art. Every asset must also appear in the world directory CREDITS file.

colors.description: Palette tokens. Same semantics as theme.json v1.

roles.description: Role -> palette token mapping. Same semantics as theme.json v1.

shape.description: Radii, shadows, grain. Unchanged from theme.json v1.

fonts.description: Font family names. Unchanged from theme.json v1.

icons.description: Shell icon set (unchanged) plus the system icon theme choice.

systemTheme.description: Installed icon theme name for KDE apps. Default breeze (recolors from the color scheme).

options.description: Shell options (dock style, notch, wallpaper, motion). Unchanged from theme.json v1.

layout.description: World behavior and arrangement, not recolor (per the concept art: each world differs in layout and behavior). Values are strings the shell defines and implements; the shell must ignore values it does not know and fall back to the default layout, so a world file never breaks the session. These fields declare intent only - shell support per value is tracked in the Worlds gap report and is the implementer's domain.

bar.description: Primary bar arrangement. Seen in the art: 'notch-island' (current default), 'top-bar', 'bottom-taskbar', 'bottom-console', 'bottom-tasks'

rail.description: Side rail: 'none' (default), 'left' (aero habitat rail, retro95 project shelf), 'right' (y2k command rail)

colorscheme.description: Generate a .colors file from colors+roles and apply with plasma-apply-colorscheme.

schemeName.description: Display name of the generated scheme, e.g. 'ElTo Soft Paper'.

kvantum.description: Optional Kvantum layer. Deferred until the colorscheme-only look is VM-checked.

theme.description: Installed xcursor theme name. Default breeze_cursors.

custom.description: Build an ElTo cursor set from SVG sources with xcursorgen, once art exists.

sourceDir.description: Asset-relative dir with cursor SVGs + index.theme manifest.

aurorae.description: Window titlebar: per-world variant generated from the ElToClassic template.

sddm.description: Login screen. Applied system-wide by elto-world install-system.

theme.description: QML theme base from the sddm spike.

layout.description: Greeter arrangement. Seen in the art: 'card-center' (aero, classic, flow, mono), 'card-left' (retro95), 'dialog-center' (faithful), 'terminal' (unix, y2k), 'pill-center' (retroaero). The QML theme must ignore unknown layouts and use its default.
Same layout vocabulary as sddm.layout; defaults to the world's sddm layout when absent.

background.description: Defaults to the sddm background when absent.

plymouth.description: Boot splash. Root layer, Phase 3, applied only by install-system after explicit approval.

spinnerFrames.description: Asset-relative glob, e.g. assets/plymouth/spinner-*.png. Keep frames few.

grub.description: Bootloader menu theme. Root layer, Phase 3. Only when ElTo-OS boots with GRUB.

colorRef.description: A palette token from colors, a role name from roles (resolved role -> token -> hex), or a literal #hex value.

asset.description: Path relative to the world directory, always under assets/.
